scripts.ldsc_sim.py: individual-level bivariate GWAS simulation; batch 1 configs
scripts.batch2.py: batch 2: M=3000, sharp overlap arms and M/N=10
scripts.exact_checks.py: exact-rational (Fraction) algebra on the Lean body

PC1_no_false_alarm.config: no LD, no overlap, M/N=0.01, h2=0.8
PC1_no_false_alarm.reading: with negligible estimation noise the Lean body is right; the harness does not manufacture a gap

PC2_defect_present_by_construction.config: no LD, M/N=1, h2=0.5 -> analytic attenuation factor exactly 1/2
PC2_defect_present_by_construction.reading: harness detects the attenuation defect class at the predicted size

OVL_negative_control.config: 100% sample overlap but rho_e = 0, true rho_g = 0
OVL_negative_control.reading: overlap alone is harmless; only overlap x phenotypic correlation biases the body. Rules out a harness that flags overlap unconditionally.

effectiveSampleSizeSE_reproduces_known_f.reading: the already-falsified definition is recovered as exactly N*2p(1-p)

ldsc_constrained_intercept_under_overlap.reading: injected defect on the LDSC side blows up exactly where the intercept is needed

findings.lean_computes: cosine similarity sum(bs*bt)/sqrt(sum bs^2 * sum bt^2) of two effect vectors
findings.standard_method: bivariate LD score regression: OLS of z1j*z2j on the LD score lj with a free intercept; slope*M/sqrt(N1N2) = genetic covariance, intercept = No*rho_pheno/sqrt(N1N2)
findings.verdict_estimand_on_true_effects: CORRECT under the standardized-genotype, mean-zero convention: lean_true = 0.60 against designed rho_g = 0.60 in every arm
findings.attenuation_law: rho_g * prod_k sqrt(h2_k*Lbar/(h2_k*Lbar + M/N_k)); at the realistic ratio M/N=10 the body returns 13% of the truth

overlap_on_top_of_signal.note: +60% inflation; sign of the inflation follows sign(rho_e)

LD_exact_counterexample.reading: exactly orthogonal joint effects (rho_g = 0) give cosine 4/5 on marginal effects; two SNPs suffice

per_allele_convention_clash.reading: Conventions/VarianceComponents treat effect vectors as per-allele alpha weighted by 2p(1-p); the Lean body weights uniformly and LDSCModel carries no allele frequencies at all, so neither the within- nor the cross-population weighted estimand is expressible

findings.verdict: NAME wrong (no LD score, no chi-squared, no intercept, no regression; ld_adj is carried by the structure and never used by the definition) + DOCSTRING overclaims by omission (says 'genetic correlation is defined by the inner product of effects' with no statement that this holds only for true, standardized, mean-zero effects at linkage equilibrium). Body is NOT numerically wrong as an estimand on true effects.

findings.standard_method: V_A = Var(sum_i alpha_i X_i) = alpha' Sigma alpha = lean sum + 4 sum_{i<j} alpha_i alpha_j D_ij
findings.size_and_direction: off by a factor of 2/3 (understates) or 2 (overstates) at r=1/2 depending on the sign of alpha_i alpha_j; error vanishes exactly at D=0
findings.verdict: DOCSTRING overclaims: 'V_A = Sum 2p(1-p)alpha^2' is stated unconditionally, with no linkage-equilibrium hypothesis. Correct under LE. Not a naming error.

findings.lean_computes: se_per_param * k < se_per_param * (k+1), i.e. k < k+1
findings.standard_method: the claim in the docstring is that constraining the LDSC intercept to 1 lowers SE(rho_g)
findings.measured: no-overlap arms, se(free) vs se(constrained) across replicates: 0.093/0.066, 0.099/0.199, 0.731/0.654, 0.245/0.071, 0.387/0.084, 0.151/0.041, 0.284/0.050 -- constrained is tighter in 6 of 7. Under 100% overlap the constrained estimator is catastrophically biased: rho_g_hat = 1.350 where the truth is 0.
findings.verdict: DOCSTRING overclaims. The empirical direction is supported when there is genuinely no overlap (6 of 7 arms), but the theorem contains no standard error at all -- it is 'k < k+1' with a variable named se_per_param -- so it is not evidence for its own docstring, and the docstring's premise ('when there is no sample overlap') is exactly the condition a user cannot check from summary statistics.

findings.standard_method: N = 1/(se^2 * 2p(1-p)) for a standardized phenotype in the small-effect limit
findings.verdict: VERIFIED CORRECT in the regime it is for (small per-SNP effect, standardized phenotype). Overstates N for large-effect SNPs (+27% at h2_snp=0.10, +64% at h2_snp=0.20); that caveat is not in the docstring.

VERIFIED CORRECT. It is a definition with no hidden content; the per-locus route to V_A_tagged agrees with the simulated variance to 0.2% under linkage equilibrium, and inherits finding 2's LD caveat when V_A_tagged is computed by that route.

not_reached: weighted / jackknifed LDSC (my implementation is unweighted OLS, so its per-replicate variance is larger than real LDSC's; every conclusion drawn from it is about the mean, not the SE)
real LD reference panel; LD is block-AR(1) Gaussian with exact analytic LD scores
cross-population LD differences (both GWASs share one LD structure here), so the cross-population part of the portability story is untested

StatisticalGeneticsMethodology sections IncrementalR2, CrossValidation, and the disjoint-window limit-variance block (lines 40-131, 464-553): these are inequalities whose hypotheses assume their conclusions, with no numeric content to differential-test
Conventions.additiveVariance was checked only through its identity with the VarianceComponents definition
